gaps.quote: Any prime larger than all nonzero numerators and denominators in the table works.
gaps.note: Too weak as stated. Numerators can be negative, so 'larger than' them is vacuous: with a numerator -6 the prime 3 is larger yet divides it. The paper (line 1417) requires a prime exceeding the absolute values of all nonzero numerators and denominators. The page also calls q an odd prime, but 'any prime larger than' these values could be 2 when all entries are 0 or 1 in absolute value; the paper (line 1415) chooses an odd prime.
